description: VelvetAccess: the Velvet key thresholds (Rep tier or companion Favour) and the small capped perks (insurance discount, free Case reveals, Face bonus, fighter Muscle bonus). Pass wallet for that wallet's Rep tier, Disk, Velvet tier and which rooms its key opens; add companionId for the Favour perks and fighterId for the Muscle bonus its fighter would give. Read only.

companionId.description: Optional: a companion the wallet owns.

fighterId.description: Optional: a fighter the wallet owns.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: get_velvet
